title: fix(shadow): pending no_open buys must reserve slots/codes
author: cursor
head: b2d75d11bbfef258858ae7cce9fb57326637acf3
body: ## Summary `propose_buy_plans` only counted open positions. After the intentional `no_open` keep-planned fix, a day where some overnight buys lack bars while other symbols still have closes could write new plans into the freed slots. Those older planned rows stayed in `shadow_trade_plans`, so the next session filled the backlog together and broke `MAX_POSITIONS` (reproduced 5 open names) or doubled the same code when `open` was missing but `close` was present. Fix: `run_shadow_session` passes unresolved planned buys into `propose_buy_plans`, which reserves both their codes and slot count before proposing. Does not change #490 (`cash=0` → `INITIAL_CAPITAL`); that remains open. ## Validation - `python3 -m pytest tests/core/test_shadow_ledger.py -q` (9 passed) - `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` on touched files - `scripts/quality_gate.py --check-functions`

adjudication.reason: the check fails the same way on the base and the head, so it did not discriminate between them
adjudication.requirement: `propose_buy_plans` must reserve both codes and slot count for unresolved planned buy orders (pending plans with status "planned" and action "buy"), not just open positions. This prevents the bug where a day with some overnight buys lacking bars could write new plans into freed slots, causing MAX_POSITIONS to be exceeded or duplicate codes.

check.contents:
"""Verify that propose_buy_plans reserves slots/codes for pending buy plans.

Regression test for PR #496: before the fix, propose_buy_plans only counted
open positions when computing reserved codes and available slots. After the
fix it also counts unresolved planned buys (pending_plans).
"""

import sys
from datetime import date

# Ensure the repo root is on sys.path
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/user/repos/WyckoffTradingAgent")

from core.shadow_ledger import (
    ShadowBook,
    ShadowPlan,
    ShadowPosition,
    propose_buy_plans,
    _pending_buy_plans,
    BUY,
    MAX_POSITIONS,
)


def test_pending_plans_reserve_slots():
    """When there are pending buy plans, they should reduce available slots."""
    # Setup: 3 open positions + 1 pending buy plan = 4 reserved (MAX_POSITIONS=4)
    book = ShadowBook(
        cash=100_000.0,
        initial_capital=100_000.0,
        positions={
            "SH600000": ShadowPosition(code="SH600000", name="PingAn Bank", shares=1000, avg_cost=10.0),
            "SH600036": ShadowPosition(code="SH600036", name="CMB", shares=500, avg_cost=35.0),
            "SZ000001": ShadowPosition(code="SZ000001", name="PBC", shares=2000, avg_cost=15.0),
        },
    )

    # Create a pending buy plan for a code NOT yet in positions
    as_of = date(2024, 1, 15)
    pending_plans = [
        ShadowPlan(
            plan_key=f"USER_SHADOW:e66942b7-be66-46fe-95ed-ebc7f3b47928:{as_of.isoformat()}:buy:SH600519",
            code="SH600519",
            name="Kweichow Moutai",
            action=BUY,
            signal_date=as_of,
            status="planned",
        ),
    ]

    # Create buy candidates that include the pending code and a new code
    buy_candidates = [
        {"code": "SH600519", "name": "Kweichow Moutai"},  # already in pending
        {"code": "SH601318", "name": "PingAn Insurance"},   # new candidate
    ]

    # Empty bars dict (we only need close prices for propose_buy_plans)
    import pandas as pd
    bars = {}

    # Call propose_buy_plans with pending_plans
    plans = propose_buy_plans(
        book,
        buy_candidates,
        bars,
        as_of,
        account_id="USER_SHADOW:e66942b7-be66-46fe-95ed-ebc7f3b47928",
        pending_plans=pending_plans,
    )

    # With 3 open positions + 1 pending = 4 reserved, MAX_POSITIONS=4, so 0 slots left
    # No new plans should be created
    assert len(plans) == 0, (
        f"Expected 0 new plans when all slots are taken by open+pending, got {len(plans)}: {[p.code for p in plans]}"
    )


def test_pending_plans_reserve_codes():
    """Pending buy plan codes should be excluded from new proposals."""
    book = ShadowBook(
        cash=100_000.0,
        initial_capital=100_000.0,
        positions={},  # No open positions
    )

    as_of = date(2024, 1, 15)
    pending_code = "SH600519"
    pending_plans = [
        ShadowPlan(
            plan_key=f"USER_SHADOW:e66942b7-be66-46fe-95ed-ebc7f3b47928:{as_of.isoformat()}:buy:{pending_code}",
            code=pending_code,
            name="Kweichow Moutai",
            action=BUY,
            signal_date=as_of,
            status="planned",
        ),
    ]

    buy_candidates = [
        {"code": pending_code, "name": "Kweichow Moutai"},  # should be excluded
        {"code": "SH601318", "name": "PingAn Insurance"},   # should be allowed
    ]

    import pandas as pd
    bars = {}

    plans = propose_buy_plans(
        book,
        buy_candidates,
        bars,
        as_of,
        account_id="USER_SHADOW:e66942b7-be66-46fe-95ed-ebc7f3b47928",
        pending_plans=pending_plans,
    )

    # The pending code should NOT appear in new plans
    plan_codes = {p.code for p in plans}
    assert pending_code not in plan_codes, (
        f"Pending code '{pending_code}' should be reserved and not proposed again, but got: {plan_codes}"
    )


def test_pending_buy_plans_helper():
    """_pending_buy_plans should return only unresolved planned buys."""
    as_of = date(2024, 1, 15)

    planned = [
        ShadowPlan(
            plan_key=f"USER_SHADOW:e66942b7-be66-46fe-95ed-ebc7f3b47928:{as_of.isoformat()}:buy:SH600000",
            code="SH600000", name="PingAn Bank", action=BUY, signal_date=as_of, status="planned",
        ),
        ShadowPlan(
            plan_key=f"USER_SHADOW:e66942b7-be66-46fe-95ed-ebc7f3b47928:{as_of.isoformat()}:sell:SH600036",
            code="SH600036", name="CMB", action="sell", signal_date=as_of, status="planned",
        ),
        ShadowPlan(
            plan_key=f"USER_SHADOW:e66942b7-be66-46fe-95ed-ebc7f3b47928:{as_of.isoformat()}:buy:SH000001",
            code="SH000001", name="Test", action=BUY, signal_date=as_of, status="filled",
        ),
    ]

    fills = [
        ShadowPlan(
            plan_key=f"USER_SHADOW:e66942b7-be66-46fe-95ed-ebc7f3b47928:{as_of.isoformat()}:buy:SH000001",
            code="SH000001", name="Test", action=BUY, signal_date=as_of, status="filled",
        ),
    ]

    pending = _pending_buy_plans(planned, fills)

    # Only the first plan should be returned (unresolved planned buy)
    assert len(pending) == 1, f"Expected 1 pending buy plan, got {len(pending)}"
    assert pending[0].code == "SH600000", f"Expected code SH600000, got {pending[0].code}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_pending_plans_reserve_slots()
    print("PASS: test_pending_plans_reserve_slots")

    test_pending_plans_reserve_codes()
    print("PASS: test_pending_plans_reserve_codes")

    test_pending_buy_plans_helper()
    print("PASS: test_pending_buy_plans_helper")

    print("\nAll tests passed!")
